findings.title: The final canonical trace gate cannot run
findings.claim: Task 3 invokes an unsupported `same` mode. The available `check` mode also rejects a baseline recorded at the unchanged sim version.
findings.why: The required per-tick preservation gate fails even if the refactor is correct.
findings.fix: Add a same-version comparison mode to the trace script and use it in Task 3, or specify another executable comparison against the Task 1 baseline.

findings.title: The factory test accepts conflicting mode identities
findings.claim: The test registers `sector-copy` with rules whose `modeId` is `sector`; the factory permits that mismatch, while the core labels replays from the rules.
findings.why: The alternate-mode test passes while its host identity and replay identity disagree, so it does not prove correct mode wiring.
findings.fix: Require `options.modeId === rules.modeId` in `defineEncounterMode`; give the test rules a matching mode ID and assert the resulting replay identity.

findings.title: The new authority equivalence test compares the core with itself
findings.claim: The test compares `createAuthority` with `createEncounterAuthority(sectorRules)`, but the plan implements the former as a direct call to the latter. Its per-tick oracle checks hashes only.
findings.why: A shared regression in admission, lease fencing, checkpoint cadence, or event ordering could satisfy the new equality test without changing a tick hash.
findings.fix: Pin a pre-refactor authority boundary trace from master, including results, events, publications, and checkpoints across lease and replay scenarios, and compare the generic core against it.
